'''Slaughter''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for killing livestock quickly: it deals heavy extra damage to farm animals and holds nearby animals in place.

== Obtaining ==
Slaughter comes on the [[Butcher's Knife]], sold by an expert-level [[Cook]] (the pack's butcher) for one [[Obol]]. The knife also has Looting II.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/butcher/4/butcher_knife.json}}</ref> No blessing or book gives Slaughter.

== Behavior ==
* '''Damage.''' Attacks deal 40 extra damage to livestock, enough to kill any of them in one hit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/slaughter.json}}</ref>
* '''Holding.''' While a player holds the weapon in the main hand, every livestock animal within 3 blocks of them gets {{EffectLink|Slowness}} X for 1 second, renewed every tick, so nearby animals cannot walk away.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/slaughter.mcfunction}}</ref>

"Livestock" is the pack's <code>#matcha:livestock</code> entity tag: chickens, cows, mooshrooms, pigs, sheep, goats, rabbits, horses, donkeys, mules and camels.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/entity_type/livestock.json}}</ref>

Slaughter can be applied to any weapon (swords, spears, axes and maces). It is exclusive with the vanilla damage enchantments. Its anvil cost multiplier is 0.
